---
title: "ojs_define from R (knitr runs first)"
engine: [knitr, ojs]
render-components:
  - \_extensions/ojs/dist/ojs-preview.tsx
---

```{r}
ojs_define(cars = head(mtcars, 3))
nrow(mtcars)
```

```{ojs2}
display(cars);
```

```{ojs1}
rows = transpose(cars)
```

```{ojs2}
display(`First row: ${rows[0].mpg} mpg, ${rows[0].cyl} cylinders`);
```
